baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive construction لِسَعْيِهَا makes the subject's own سعي the explicit relation of راضية.
baseline_models.mechanism: سعي as work and earning supplies something performed and owned; رضا as acceptance then functions as an appraisal of that work rather than undirected pleasure.

activation_trace.role: Work, earning, and active endeavor make the possessed سعي the concrete performance being appraised.
Acceptance opposed to displeasure supplies the favorable verdict on that performance.

changed_reading.before: The subject is simply pleased, with striving named as a general occasion.
changed_reading.after: The subject accepts her own concrete work and earnings as worthwhile; the striving itself has become satisfactory rather than wasted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَعْي names a possessed course of action, while رَاضِيَة names the state reached in relation to it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The movement branch gives سعي a desired destination, and the approval branch lets رضا mark the achieved end-state of that directed passage.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful going toward a sought object turns the striving into a directed trajectory.
Abundant or sought approval supplies the trajectory's desired terminus.

changed_reading.before: Her striving is an abstract stock of deeds.
changed_reading.after: Her striving is purposeful movement that has reached what it sought, and satisfaction is its arrival condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins a branch of noble social striving to a branch of reciprocal رضا without adding another object.
baseline_models.mechanism: سعي can be an undertaking of generosity or peacemaking, while رضا can be mutual consent; together they support satisfaction as a repaired social relation produced by her effort.

activation_trace.role: Noble generosity and peacemaking supply a socially reparative kind of striving.
Mutual consent supplies the concord that the reparative effort brings about.

changed_reading.before: Satisfaction is a private feeling about private effort.
changed_reading.after: Her striving may have made peace or carried generosity, so her satisfaction includes restored consent between parties.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The agency branch of سعي and the obedient or guaranteeing branch of رضا both attach directly to the two focus roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: The possessed striving can be read as discharge of an entrusted office over others; satisfaction follows from faithful, answerable performance of that charge.

activation_trace.role: Agency or office over a group supplies an entrusted social task for the striving.
Obedience, love, or guarantee supplies faithful answerability within that entrusted task.

changed_reading.before: Her striving is only personal exertion.
changed_reading.after: Her striving can be the responsible execution of a charge, with satisfaction arising from having answered for it faithfully.

context_deltas.mechanism: The all-enveloping event polarizes visible faces into lowered and softened conditions. The feminine-singular راضية can continue that facial subject, making satisfaction with striving an embodied, publicly legible verdict and not merely hidden emotion.

activation_trace.role: Concrete work remains the conduct whose result becomes visible.
Acceptance supplies the inward state that the face exteriorizes.
An event that envelops everyone supplies the common exposure under which opposed outcomes become legible.
The literal face or front supplies the visible bearer of the first condition.
Lowering and submission give the negative face a bodily posture.
Face standing for the whole self lets visible expression carry a total personal verdict.
Softness and ease supply the positive face's perceptible condition immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 88:2 and 88:8 repeat the same face-and-day frame with opposed feminine-singular predicates; 88:9 adds another feminine-singular predicate without naming a new subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated faces and the agreement pattern; I infer that ellipsis carries those faces into 88:9 and that facial state indexes the whole self. A live alternative is an unstated feminine subject such as the soul.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an inward subject who feels pleased about her work.
changed_reading.after: Her accepted striving has become a verdict written on the face: inward acceptance is outwardly and bodily evident under the common event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding negative sequence separates quantity of labor from efficacy: work can exhaust yet fail to nourish or suffice. Against that failure, رضا for one's سعي becomes satisfaction with effective, outcome-bearing endeavor, not admiration of exertion as such.

activation_trace.role: Work and earning supply the positive sequence's own term for active endeavor.
Acceptance supplies the favorable assessment that futile labor lacks.
Purposeful action supplies a close comparator for the focus's striving.
Exhausting trouble marks labor whose intensity does not secure a good outcome.
Sufficiency supplies the explicit criterion that the negative provision fails.
Emptiness and wasting supply the unresolved need left by ineffective provision.

structural_cues: 88:3 couples labor with exhaustion, while 88:6-7 repeat negation and deny both nourishment and sufficiency before the positive reversal of 88:8-9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labor, fatigue, and failed sufficiency; I infer that the contrast evaluates work by what it effects rather than how painful it is. A live alternative is that all labor is simply rewarded or punished independently of efficacy.

changed_reading.before: Her satisfaction rewards the fact that she exerted herself.
changed_reading.after: Her satisfaction answers the fruitfulness of her striving: unlike exhausting labor that leaves need intact, this endeavor reaches a fitting result.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, an enclosed garden contains provision that flows continuously and furnishings already raised, placed, aligned, and spread. This changes رضا for prior سعي into permission to cease producing and receive from an order that is already sustaining.

activation_trace.role: Active work supplies the labor whose mode changes in the prepared setting.
Acceptance supplies the transition from producing to receiving.
A garden sheltered by its trees supplies the containing habitat for the result.
Continuing provision and giving make sustenance ongoing without renewed exertion by the beneficiary.
A place of settled reclining supplies repose as the new bodily mode.
Already elevated furnishings supply completed preparation.
Objects placed in their appointed location supply readiness for use.
Alignment on an even line supplies deliberate order rather than unfinished setup.
Spreading things throughout the space supplies complete availability across the habitat.

structural_cues: 88:10-16 move from the worker to a repeated فيه/فيها inventory of an environment whose flow continues and whose objects stand in completed arrangements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flowing provision and resultative arrangements; I infer that they answer and terminate the earlier mode of striving, so satisfaction includes release from maintenance. A live alternative is that the list only names rewards and says nothing about cessation.

changed_reading.before: She is pleased because her completed work has earned desirable objects.
changed_reading.after: She is pleased because work can give way to repose inside a prepared order where provision now flows and the habitat does the sustaining.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same context root first images a worker worn down by naṣab and later a mountain made to stand by naṣb. The focus sits between those poles, allowing satisfactory striving to mark a transfer from carrying instability in the body to inhabiting a world whose weight has been set into stable structure.

activation_trace.role: Work and endeavor supply the activity whose burden is being reconfigured.
Acceptance marks the subject's release from the first pole of exhausting labor.
Wearisome affliction locates naṣb inside the laboring body.
Erecting something as a prominent stable object relocates naṣb into the world's structure.

structural_cues: The root ن ص ب recurs in 88:3 and 88:19 on opposite sides of the focus, and the branchless repeated ك ي ف makes the later emplacement a process to inspect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two branch-backed senses of the repeated root; I supply the arrow that bodily burden is redistributed into environmental stability. A live alternative is that exhaustion and emplacement are independent senses with no transfer between them.

changed_reading.before: Satisfactory striving is successful labor while the worker remains its load-bearing center.
changed_reading.after: Satisfactory striving culminates when burden no longer consumes the worker and stability has been built into the world around her.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inspection sequence presents an adapted traveler inside a vertically and horizontally ordered field: an enduring camel, measured aptitude, elevated sky, solid mountains, lower ground, and an extended surface. Purposeful سعي is therefore not isolated willpower but successful coupling between agent and affordant world.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful going supplies the locomotor action whose conditions the creation sequence can expose.
Acceptance supplies felt consonance between the moving agent and the fitted field.
Directed sight or insight turns the sequence into inspection of how the mechanism works.
The camel's ability to manage without water supplies an organism fitted for sustained passage.
Aptitude and preparedness supply the creature-to-task fit rather than bare existence.
Elevation supplies the upper coordinate of the traversed field.
Solid elevated masses supply stable structure within that field.
The lower realm opposed to sky supplies the ground coordinate.
A level extended surface supplies the direct affordance for purposeful movement.

structural_cues: The branchless cue ك ي ف repeats at 88:17-20, forcing procedural attention across creature, sky, mountains, and earth rather than a static list.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection, creaturely aptitude, and a layered extended environment; I infer that these form a locomotion system supporting سعي. A live alternative is that the sequence is general evidence of creation with no special relation to the focus's effort.

changed_reading.before: Her satisfaction proves the independent strength of her purposeful effort.
changed_reading.after: Her satisfaction registers a fit: purposeful agency succeeded because creature, capacity, route, and world answered one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory permits office over people and denunciation to authority, but the context excludes corrupt speech and defines the communicative office as reminder rather than controlling oversight. The agency reading survives only as responsible, noncoercive service.

activation_trace.role: Office over people supplies the social-agency baseline that the context constrains.
Denunciation to authority supplies the coercive or accusatory failure mode of that agency.
Obedience, love, or guarantee preserves answerable service after domination is removed.
False or ugly speech excludes tale-bearing from the satisfactory communicative order.
Reminder as that which makes another remember supplies a bounded positive office.
The controlling overseer supplies the role explicitly denied to the addressee.

structural_cues: The sequence permits reminding in 88:21 and immediately negates controlling authority in 88:22; 88:11 has already removed corrupt speech from the positive setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reminder/control boundary and an earlier speech filter; I apply that boundary as pressure on the focus root's office and denunciation branches. A live alternative is that the limit concerns only the addressed messenger and does not constrain other agency readings.

changed_reading.before: Her satisfaction can come from successfully administering, reporting, or controlling others.
changed_reading.after: If the office resonance remains, satisfaction belongs to faithful reminder and service without accusation or domination; the striving stays answerable but not coercive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opens with coming and closes with return, placing the focus's purposeful movement inside an arrival-return circuit. Satisfaction becomes the closure of a trajectory rather than a static feeling attached to a ledger of deeds.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful going supplies the directed middle movement of the circuit.
Acceptance supplies the settled state when that movement closes.
Coming or arrival supplies the opening directional pole.
Return to a homeward place supplies the closing directional pole.

structural_cues: The first ayah asks whether the report has come to the addressee, while 88:25 states that their return is toward Us; the focus's movement term lies between these directional endpoints.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening arrival, a central purposeful motion, and a closing return; I read them as a shared trajectory frame. A live alternative is that the arrival governs only the report and the return only the people, without forming one circuit.

changed_reading.before: Her striving is a completed quantity retained for appraisal.
changed_reading.after: Her striving is the outbound portion of a course that finds its true completion in return, and satisfaction is arrival after directed movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement to divine return and accounting prevents رضا from being self-certifying. The reciprocal-consent branch allows a coexisting reading in which her acceptance of her striving and the final evaluator's acceptance converge.

activation_trace.role: Work and earning supply the owned conduct that can be brought into account.
Mutual consent supplies concord between the subject's satisfaction and an answering approval.
The worshiped deity supplies the personal evaluator named before return and account.
Return to the destination brings the worker and her conduct before that evaluator.
Counting and accounting supply the external reckoning against which satisfaction is tested.

structural_cues: The closing sequence moves from named divine action to return 'to Us' and then account 'upon Us,' shifting final assessment away from the worker alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine agency, return, and account; I infer that the possessed سعي is among what the account evaluates and that reciprocal رضا can mark ratification. A live alternative is that the account ranges over the whole person while راضية remains purely experiential.

changed_reading.before: She is satisfied because she herself judges her striving favorably.
changed_reading.after: Her satisfaction can be a concordant verdict: she accepts her striving because return and account have also ratified it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because both branches are isolated idioms of overcoming while the surface forms ordinarily evoke striving and satisfaction. It remains anchored because the two focus-root inventories independently converge on contest resolution; downstream prose should call it a branch resonance, not translate the ayah as conquest.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both سَعْيِهَا and رَاضِيَة have focus-inventory branches in which engagement with another ends in prevailing.

activation_trace.role: Rivaling and prevailing in a striving supplies the contest's active phase.
Overcoming another in the matter supplies the same contest's resolved outcome.

changed_reading.before: Satisfaction is placid contentment after effort.
changed_reading.after: A faint double-root resonance makes satisfaction the composure after a striving has prevailed in contest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the focus root, whose branch concerns neglected loose wandering. It remains packet-anchored and gains a coherent contrast from camel movement, traversable ground, and return; downstream prose should present it only as a split-root counterimage, never as the lexical sense of سعي here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps the focus root س ع ي secondarily to a branch of movement that goes loose or becomes lost.

activation_trace.role: Neglected wandering supplies the risk that movement disperses without a governing end.
Acceptance supplies settlement after the risk of aimless dispersal.
Camels and their tending make governed versus untended movement materially imaginable.
An extended surface supplies the open field across which motion could either stray or stay directed.
Return to a homeward place gathers open-ended movement into a terminus.

changed_reading.before: Her purposeful movement is satisfactory simply because it advances.
changed_reading.after: Satisfaction marks movement rescued from loose wandering: what could have dispersed across the open field is gathered into a homeward return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch is the specialized labor of a slave earning release, and the later clientage and accounting branches only activate an analogy, not a stated legal scene. It remains anchored in the focus's own سعي inventory and a coherent release-ledger mechanism; downstream prose should label it an emancipation image rather than a direct historical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory explicitly includes earning toward manumission as a branch of the possessed سعي.

activation_trace.role: Earning toward the price of freedom supplies a legally measured striving for release.
Acceptance supplies the settled state after the claim has been discharged.
A relation involving kinship, manumission, or clientage keeps the release image socially structured.
Counting and accounting supply the ledger by which the remaining claim reaches zero.

changed_reading.before: Her work earns a reward added to her possession.
changed_reading.after: Her work can image earnings that remove a claim upon her, so satisfaction is release from bondage after the account is discharged.

strongest_changes: The repeated face grammar turns private satisfaction into an embodied and publicly legible verdict.
The failed labor and failed nourishment sequence makes efficacy, not sheer exhaustion, the decisive contrast for سعي.
The prepared garden and creation sequence shift agency from isolated effort toward repose and fit within a sustaining order.
Return and account keep satisfaction from being self-certifying and permit a coexisting reading of ratified approval.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports unusually strong cross-branch reversals: ن ص ب moves from bodily exhaustion to erected stability, both focus roots carry rare prevailing idioms, and the split س ع ي mapping exposes loose wandering as the counterimage of purposeful return. Social branches also keep noble reconciliation, bounded office, and emancipation live beside the stronger work-and-acceptance reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The implicit subject of راضية is strongly cued as the preceding faces, but an unstated feminine subject such as the soul remains possible.
The lām in لِسَعْيِهَا can weight cause, regard, benefit, or result differently, altering how tightly satisfaction evaluates the work.
The closing account may ratify this specific سعي, or it may frame the whole person while the focus remains experiential.
The contest, wandering, office, and manumission readings are inventory-backed but form-distant and must remain qualified exploratory activations.
